
---mode: agentdescription: Batch 11c. Stop Splitwise double posts and double payments, tidy key handling, and three small domain fixes. About 40K tokens.---
Build batch 11c only. Fix only what is listed.
Read: `.github/prompts/PROGRESS.md`, `src/adapters/splitwise.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ActivityView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SettleView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/PeopleView.tsx`, `tests/splitwise.test.ts`.
## Fix
1. A `posting` post is never saved to disk.   - `LocalApp.tsx` passes `saveNow(ledger)` to `ActivityView`. When a file handle is open, it saves that exact ledger and marks it saved. In download mode it does nothing.   - `ActivityView` builds the ledger with the `posting` post, updates state, awaits `saveNow`, and only then calls `postExpense`.2. Successful posts get wiped. A post is removed only when the response has a non-empty `errors`. Any other failure after a request was sent becomes `unknown`, including a bad body or a missing id.3. Stuck posts. A `posting` post that is not in flight in this tab shows the same "Check Splitwise before retrying" with "Mark posted" and "Clear" as `unknown`.4. No repost of Splitwise-born entries. Hide "Post to Splitwise" when the entry has `splitwiseExpenseId`.5. False "changed" items.   - Add optional `remoteUpdatedAt` to a post. On `posted`, leave it null.   - In `pullIntoInbox`, compare Splitwise `updated_at` with `remoteUpdatedAt`. When it is null, set it and do not flag the expense as changed.   - Take `pulledAt` before the fetch.6. Double payments. In `SettleView.tsx`, "Record" shows only for a `new` payment item, and only when no settlement has that `splitwisePaymentId`.7. Key handling, in `PeopleView.tsx`:   - If connecting fails, call `setKey("")`.   - Add Disconnect, which clears the key.   - The key input has `autoComplete="new-password"`.   - Link and pull controls show only after a successful connect.   - The error shows once.8. Network errors: when `fetch` throws, say "The browser could not reach Splitwise. It may be offline, or Splitwise may block calls from a web page (CORS)."9. Confirm before every post. "Post to Splitwise" only prepares a draft. Nothing is sent until "Post expense".   - The panel always shows, for a friend and for a group: description, date, cost, and every share. Description, date, cost, and every owed amount are editable, including yours.   - A group lists every member with a checkbox, ticked by default. Unticked members are left out, and at least one other member stays ticked. Changing the ticks splits the group portion again, equally, with leftover cents to the first ticked member. The user can then edit the amounts.   - "Post expense" stays disabled until the paid shares and the owed shares each sum to the cost. Otherwise say "Shares must add up to the cost."   - These edits change the Splitwise draft only. The ledger entry stays as it is. Cancel posts nothing.
## Small domain fixes
Search for each function and read only it.
10. `openItems` in `src/domain/ledger.ts` applies settlements in array order. Sort them by date, then id.11. `cardCycle` in `src/domain/transfers.ts` counts any positive row as the previous payment. Count only rows whose entry is a `transfer`.12. `parseAmount` in `src/adapters/csv-mapping.ts`: accept accounting negatives like `(12.30)`, which means -1230 cents.
## Tests
- One in `tests/splitwise.test.ts`, no network: a pull where the post has `remoteUpdatedAt` null does not mark that expense as changed, and sets `remoteUpdatedAt`.- One in `tests/ledger.test.ts`: two settlements saved out of date order still clear the oldest open item first.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. With your key, if the browser allows it, open Post to Splitwise, change the description, confirm, and only then post one small expense. Reload, pull, and confirm it does not show as changed. Then delete it in Splitwise. If CORS blocks every call, write that in `PROGRESS.md` and tell the user. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 11d.
